data.one_liner: A plugin for device_preview that allows taking screenshots.
data.what_it_does: A plugin for device_preview that adds a menu to take a screenshot of the current preview. By default, it displays screenshots as base64 image data in the console and saves them to your clipboard, with options to customize how they are saved.
use_when: You are using device_preview and want to capture screenshots of your app preview.
You want to copy captured preview screenshots directly to your clipboard or output them as base64.
avoid_when: You are not using device_preview in your application.
You need standard device-level screenshots outside of the device_preview environment.
strengths: Customizable screenshot storage and processing via onScreenshot.
Defaults to copying screenshots to the clipboard and logging base64.
weaknesses: Strictly dependent on the device_preview package.
Limited functionality outside of the device_preview ecosystem.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and include DevicePreviewScreenshot in your DevicePreview tools property.
